Label: Health Score
Description: Official Health Score in Salesforce for Accounts

Label: NPS Avg (Last 90 Days)
Description: Average NPS score from Survey_Response__c records (Chameleon) where Response_Date_Time__c is within last 90 days. Source score field: Survey_Response__c. Account relationship is cross-object: Survey_Response__c.Contact__c → Contact.AccountId. Populated by Rollup Helper.

Label: NPS Response Count (12 Mo)
Description: Count of Survey_Response__c records (Chameleon) where Response_Date_Time__c is within last 12 months. Account relationship is cross-object: Survey_Response__c.Contact__c → Contact.AccountId. Populated by Rollup Helper.

Label: Active Stripe Subscriptions
Description: Count of Stripe_Subscription__c records where Stripe_Status__c = 'active'. Populated by Rollup Helper.

Label: Stripe Payment Past Due
Description: TRUE if the Stripe_Customer__c record linked to this account has Stripe_Delinquent__c = true, OR if any Stripe_Subscription__c has Stripe_Status__c = 'past_due'. Populated by Rollup Helper or Flow.

Label: Stripe Subscription Canceling
Description: TRUE if any Stripe_Subscription__c on this account has Stripe_Cancel_At_Period_End__c = true. This is a leading churn indicator. Populated by Rollup Helper.

Label: Last CSM Activity Date
Description: Date of most recent Task or Event logged against this account. Populated by Rollup Helper using MAX of ActivityDate on Task/Event where WhatId = Account.Id.

Label: Days Since Last CSM Activity
Description: Calculated days since last CSM activity. NULL if no activity date exists.

Label: CM Pulse Last Updated
Description: Date the CM last updated the Pulse Score. Auto-stamped by Flow.

Label: CM Pulse Notes
Description: No Longer in use

Label: CM Pulse Score
Description: CIM/Customer Manager's qualitative assessment of account health. This is the CM's own judgment — not derived from metrics. CMs are accountable for keeping this current. This replaces vitally_CSM_Pulse__c as the source of truth.

Label: CM Pulse Days Since Update
Description: Days since the CM last updated their Pulse score. Used to flag stale scores.

Label: CM Pulse Score (Numeric)
Description: Numeric mapping of CM Pulse for reporting and sorting. Green=10, Yellow=5, Red=2.

Label: NPS Sub-Score
Description: Normalized 0-10 sub-score for the Product Health Score. Based on NPS_Avg_Last_90d__c with a recency penalty if no responses in 6+ months.

Label: Payment Sub-Score
Description: Normalized 0-10 sub-score for the Product Health Score. Based on Stripe payment status, delinquency, and cancellation signals.

Label: Engagement Sub-Score
Description: Normalized 0-10 sub-score for the Product Health Score. Based on days since last CSM activity on the account.

Label: Product Adoption Score
Description: Quantitative account health score 0-10. Combines NPS (25%), CSAT (25%), Payment (25%), and Engagement (25%). Data-driven counterpart to the CM Pulse Score. NPS source: Survey_Response__c (Chameleon). CSAT source: asknicely__NPS__c (AskNicely, score mapped from 1-5 scale).

Label: Product Health Breakdown
Description: Sub-score breakdown showing what's driving the Product Health Score. Format: NPS/CSAT/Payment/Engagement, each at 25%.

Label: Product Health Label
Description: Text label for the Product Health Score tier.

Label: Score Alignment
Description: Flags whether CM Pulse and Product Health Score agree or diverge.

Label: CSM User ID
Description: 18-char User ID of the assigned CSM (CSM_v2__c). Used as the first filter on banner reports so the ?fv0= URL parameter can pass a User ID for pre-filtering.

Label: CSAT Avg (Last 90 Days)
Description: Average CSAT score from asknicely__NPS__c records (AskNicely) where asknicely__surveyresponded__c is within last 90 days. Source score field: asknicely__score__c (scale 1–5). Account relationship: asknicely__NPS__c.asknicely__Person__c → Contact → AccountId. Populated by Rollup Helper.

Label: CSAT Response Count (12 Mo)
Description: Count of asknicely__NPS__c records (AskNicely) where asknicely__surveyresponded__c is within last 12 months. Account relationship: asknicely__NPS__c.asknicely__Person__c → Contact → AccountId. Populated by Rollup Helper.

Label: CSAT Sub-Score
Description: CSAT sub-score on 0–10 scale derived from CSAT_Avg_90d__c (AskNicely, 0–10 scale). Direct pass-through since AskNicely scores are already 0–10. Defaults to 5 (neutral) when no CSAT data. Component of Product_Health_Score__c at 25% weight.

Label: Anticipated # of Providers
Description: Anticipated number of providers at the customer organization. Inherited from Healthie Organization via flow; not user-editable.

Label: Customer Onboarding Score
Description: A calculated customer onboarding score based on a TaskRay Project related to this Account. Based on a project's Initial Estimated Duration vs. Actual Duration and the average of Internal & External Sentiment.

Label: Desired Outcomes
Description: A customer's desired outcome(s) for their onboarding process. Can be populated from the Desired Outcomes field on TaskRay Project.

Label: Reason for Pulse
Description: CM's explanation of why this account is rated Green/Yellow/Red. Required for Yellow and Red accounts.
